answer: Each new identity must pass a heartbeat probation: it signs a beacon every epoch for 12 consecutive epochs, and a missed beat resets the count. Beacons are rate-limited per network prefix, so a lotus operator running k fakes needs k parallel schedules, and the pulse capacity per prefix halves with each extra identity. Validators verify beacon signatures and prefix counts on-chain, so a sybil who must wander across many prefixes pays rising hosting costs.
